result.instructions: Tools for Loox, hosted by usefulapi.io. If the user is new or asks what this server can do, suggest requests such as: "Show the 1 and 2 star product reviews from the last 30 days."; "Which reviews are still pending approval?"; "What is the average rating of product 7891234567890?". Read-only tools never change data; ask the user before a tool that creates, changes or deletes Loox data. Free plan: 50 tool calls per month. Run loox_usage_status to see the calls used this month. If the user asks for something none of these tools can do, tell the user and, with their OK, run loox_request_feature to record the request. Paid plans: Pro (10,000 tool calls a month, $9/month or $90/year, for normal use) and Pro+ (100,000 tool calls a month, $39/month or $390/year, for automations and heavy use). A plan can be cancelled at any time and then runs to the end of the paid period, so it also suits a one-time job. When the user wants more calls or reaches the limit, run loox_upgrade without a plan: it returns both plans, each with a payment link for the user to open. loox_cancel_subscription cancels Pro at the end of the paid period.

tools.name: loox_list_product_reviews
tools.title: List product reviews
tools.description: List product reviews of the store, newest or best first, with rating, text, photos/videos, merchant reply, product, verified-purchase flag, AI highlights, country and moderation status. Merchant data: includes the reviewer's name, email, Shopify customer id and order id. Filter by product, star rating, status (default: published only; use pending to find reviews awaiting approval) and date range. Real time. GET /api/v1/store/{id}/product-reviews.

product_id.description: Only reviews of this Shopify product id.

rating.description: Only reviews with one of these star ratings (1-5), e.g. [1,2] for the unhappy ones.

status.description: Moderation status filter. Default published. pending = awaiting publishing, unpublished = hidden, all = every status.

sort.description: Sort order (default featured: pinned, then photo/video reviews, then date). ai needs Smart Visual Sorting (Convert plan).

direction.description: Sort direction (default desc). With sort=rating, desc = highest first.

from_date.description: Only reviews dated on or after this day (yyyy-mm-dd, inclusive).

to_date.description: Only reviews dated on or before this day (yyyy-mm-dd, inclusive).

page.description: Page number, from 1 (default 1). Pass the previous reply's next_page.

tools.name: loox_get_product_review
tools.title: Get product review
tools.description: One product review by id, any moderation status (published, unpublished or pending), with full reviewer details. Merchant data: includes the reviewer's name, email, Shopify customer id and order id. GET /api/v1/store/{id}/product-reviews/{reviewId}.

review_id.description: Loox review id (the `id` of a review from a list tool).

tools.name: loox_list_store_reviews
tools.title: List store reviews
tools.description: List store-level reviews (about the shop, not one product) with rating, text, merchant reply and moderation status. Merchant data: includes the reviewer's name, email, Shopify customer id and order id. Filter by star rating, status (default published) and date range (applied to createdAt). GET /api/v1/store/{id}/store-reviews.

rating.description: Only reviews with one of these star ratings (1-5), e.g. [1,2] for the unhappy ones.

status.description: Moderation status filter. Default published. pending = awaiting publishing, unpublished = hidden, all = every status.

sort.description: Sort order (default featured: highest-quality reviews first, then date).

direction.description: Sort direction (default desc). With sort=rating, desc = highest first.

from_date.description: Only reviews created on or after this day (yyyy-mm-dd, inclusive).

to_date.description: Only reviews created on or before this day (yyyy-mm-dd, inclusive).

page.description: Page number, from 1 (default 1). Pass the previous reply's next_page.

tools.name: loox_get_store_review
tools.title: Get store review
tools.description: One store-level review by id, any moderation status, with full reviewer details. Merchant data: includes the reviewer's name, email, Shopify customer id and order id. GET /api/v1/store/{id}/store-reviews/{reviewId}.

review_id.description: Loox review id (the `id` of a review from a list tool).

tools.name: loox_get_product_reviews_summary
tools.title: Get product reviews summary
tools.description: Overall rating of the store's published product reviews: total count, average stars and how many reviews per star (1-5). Public Storefront API, published reviews only. GET /storefront/v1/store/{id}/product-reviews/bottomline.

tools.name: loox_get_product_rating
tools.title: Get product rating
tools.description: Review count and average star rating of ONE product (published reviews; 0 when it has none). Public Storefront API. GET /storefront/v1/store/{id}/product-reviews/bottomline/{productId}.

tools.name: loox_get_store_reviews_summary
tools.title: Get store reviews summary
tools.description: Overall rating of the store-level reviews: total count, average stars and how many reviews per star (1-5). Public Storefront API, published reviews only. GET /storefront/v1/store/{id}/store-reviews/bottomline.

prompts.name: getting_started
prompts.title: Get started with Loox
prompts.description: What you can do with Loox here, with example requests to try.

prompts.name: find_products_with_1_and_2_star_reviews
prompts.title: Find products with 1 and 2 star reviews
prompts.description: The AI lists published reviews with 1 or 2 stars in a date range and reads the review text, product and merchant reply. You see which products get complaints and what they say.

prompts.name: check_reviews_waiting_for_approval
prompts.title: Check reviews waiting for approval
prompts.description: The AI lists reviews with the pending status and shows rating, text and product for each one. You can see what is waiting and what needs a decision.

prompts.name: summarize_what_customers_praise_and_dislike
prompts.title: Summarize what customers praise and dislike
prompts.description: The AI reads review text, photo reviews and AI highlights for one product or the whole store. It sums up common praise and complaints.

prompts.name: compare_the_rating_of_products_and_the_store
prompts.title: Compare the rating of products and the store
prompts.description: The AI gets the review count and average stars of single products, plus the count per star for all product reviews. You can compare products and spot weak ones.

prompts.name: read_store_reviews_about_your_shop
prompts.title: Read store reviews about your shop
prompts.description: The AI reads store-level reviews (about the shop, not one product) by star rating and date. It shows the average, the count per star and the main themes.
